items.description: Landlord must give Tenant an Outage Credit for each separate Interruption of Essential Services, in the amount set out in the tables by duration.
items.span_text: (1) Upon the occurrence of each Separate/Independent Interruption of Landlord’s Essential Services, Tenant shall be entitled to an Outage Credit in the amount set forth opposite the duration of such Interruption of Landlord’s Essential Services in Table 2.A.(1)-A and 2.A.(1)-B, below, as applicable:
items.trigger: Upon the occurrence of each Separate/Independent Interruption of Landlord’s Essential Services

items.description: Landlord must give Tenant a Partial Outage Credit of one-half of an Outage Credit for each Loss of Redundancy lasting at least 168 consecutive hours.
items.span_text: (2) Upon the occurrence of each Loss of Redundancy that occurs for at least one hundred sixty eight (168) consecutive hours (i.e., seven (7) full twenty-four (24) hour periods), Tenant shall be entitled to one-half (1/2) of an Outage Credit (each, a “Partial Outage Credit”) as set forth opposite the duration of such Loss of Redundancy in Table 2.A.(2), below:
items.trigger: Upon the occurrence of each Loss of Redundancy that occurs for at least one hundred sixty eight (168) consecutive hours

items.description: If an Outage Credit or Partial Outage Credit accrues in the final month of the Term, Landlord must pay its amount to Tenant within thirty days after the Term expires.
items.span_text: provided, however, in the event that an Outage Credit or Partial Outage Credit accrues during the final month of the Term, Landlord will pay to Tenant the amount of the Outage Credit or Partial Outage Credit within thirty (30) days following the expiration of the Term.
items.trigger: in the event that an Outage Credit or Partial Outage Credit accrues during the final month of the Term

items.description: Earned Outage Credits or Partial Outage Credits are applied as a credit against Tenant's Base Rent due in the next month of the Term.
items.span_text: the Outage Credit or Partial Outage Credit, as applicable, shall be applied as a credit towards Tenant’s Base Rent due in the immediately following month of the Term;
items.trigger: In the event that Tenant is entitled to an Outage Credit or Partial Outage Credit

items.description: After curing an Interruption or Loss of Redundancy, Landlord must give Tenant the Interruption Cure Completion Notice as soon as reasonably practicable.
items.span_text: Once Landlord has rectified a particular Interruption of Landlord’s Essential Services or Loss of Redundancy, Landlord shall provide the Interruption Cure Completion Notice to Tenant as soon as is reasonably practicable thereafter.
items.trigger: Once Landlord has rectified a particular Interruption of Landlord’s Essential Services or Loss of Redundancy

items.description: Landlord and Tenant must meet periodically at Tenant's request, and at least annually, to review Landlord's performance against the performance standards.
items.span_text: The Tenant and Landlord will meet periodically at Tenant’s request, but no less than annually, to review the Landlord’s performance and compliance with the performance standards, as specified in this Exhibit.

items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease by timely delivering the Continuous Outage Termination Notice to Landlord after a Continuous Outage.
items.span_text: In the event of a Continuous Outage, Tenant may terminate this Lease by timely delivery of the Continuous Outage Termination Notice to Landlord.
items.trigger: In the event of a Continuous Outage

items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease by timely delivering the Chronic Outage Termination Notice to Landlord after a Chronic Outage.
items.span_text: In the event of a Chronic Outage, Tenant may terminate this Lease by timely delivery of the Chronic Outage Termination Notice to Landlord.
